Elizabeth Olsen stars in director Sean Durkin's psychological thriller, MARTHA
MARCY MAY MARLENE, about a young woman who undergoes an explosive crisis
of identity after escaping the confines of a rural cult-like farming community.
Trapped by unsettling flashes of memories from the past and visions of a perilous
future, she becomes taken over by an unsettling sense of fear, leaving her
consumed by paranoia and a mysterious burden of guilt.
